transcript: Hello {{addressee}}, and welcome. This briefing walks through what we found when we looked at how modern AI search tools describe {{company}}, as of {{capturedDate}}.

First, a word about your standing. Your reputation across {{territory}} was built the right way, through years of referred work and real results. Nothing about your operation is broken. The way people look for firms like yours has changed shape.

Today, a growing share of high value searches never reach a list of websites. Buyers ask an assistant who they should call, and the assistant answers from structured records it can read. Where those records are missing or unclear, it stays silent about the firm, or names a competitor instead.
That is the gap in your findings. Your real world authority is strong. Your machine readable record of it is not yet complete, and that is a fixable problem, not a verdict on your business.
We left the research open for you in the Ignition Hub. Ask it anything, follow every answer back to its source, and take as long as you like. There is no sales pressure attached to any of it.

When you are ready, reach out directly. Until then, keep this transcript, share it with the people you trust, and ask your favorite AI assistant to challenge it. The strongest findings hold up under questions.
